issues.title: 响应闭集仍不能唯一表达 query failure、Apply Recovery 终态和 Manual 保存后的 dispatch failure
issues.evidence: Candidate-003 closes the success DTOs and selector read-back states, but three concrete wire states remain implementation-defined. First, SnapshotResult names QueryError without defining its closed codes, so an exact TypeScript parser cannot distinguish or reject unknown query failures. Second, after structural Save, an old-child stop failure leaves runtimeState=recoveryRequired with the old applied identity, yet savedApplyFailed.error may be either stopFailed or recoveryRequired; similarly candidate spawn/Ready cleanup failure can be startFailed or recoveryRequired. The design lists all codes but does not give the unique DCR-004 state-to-code mapping required by review-002. Third, after a Manual selection save succeeds while the owned runtime is Ready and the Pool/Node are in AppliedRoutingIndex, a worker dispatch/queue failure before any PUT/GET has no truthful closed outcome: selectorSavedOnly reasons are only runtimeStopped/runtimeNotReady/notInAppliedArtifact, selectorApplyUnknown reasons are only readBackUnavailable/unknownRuntimeNode/instanceChanged/superseded, and runtimeUnavailable is forbidden after save. Returning error would hide the committed desired selection; using an existing reason would state an event that did not occur. These are current reachable transaction/failure sequences, not future extensibility concerns.
issues.required_change: Complete only T012-DESIGN-008: define QueryError as an explicit closed scalar/union; freeze one unique runtimeState + applyState/error mapping for each DCR-004 terminal sequence (at minimum configuration/check failure, pre-commit state change, old-child stop failure, candidate spawn/Ready failure with successful cleanup, and cleanup failure/RecoveryRequired); and either prove the selector dispatch cannot fail after persistence or add one exact post-save ok outcome reason that truthfully covers pre-I/O dispatch unavailability. Keep every post-save Manual result as ok + authoritative snapshot, retain the existing MutationResult outer shape, and add the corresponding Rust serialization and TypeScript exact-parser fixtures. No new IPC, persisted field, schema version, runtime abstraction, or TASK-012 scope is needed.

remaining_risks: The fixed sing-box 1.14.0 selector PUT/GET URL, request body, and response shape still require implementation-stage fixture evidence; the design correctly requires fail-closed behavior and this does not block design once the wire gap is closed.
DCR-019 projection behavior, selector runtime behavior, and all visual states remain unimplemented and unverified; this review does not treat design text as runtime evidence.
Cross-subscription data rollback remains roll-forward-first and requires the documented data convergence plus successful Apply before old projection code can be considered safe.
No production build, test, Windows runtime, or UI verification was run because this is an independent design review before implementation.
